flora: Deeply-lobed fan leaf (close-up of a fan leaf distinctly divided into 4-6 narrow, strap-like segments)
Fleshy seed cluster (a pair of smooth, oval, plum-like pale yellow seeds on a shared woody stalk)
Woody spur branchlet (a short, stout, heavily wrinkled wood twig showing concentric growth rings)
Autumnal yellow leaf (a fallen, bright mustard-yellow fan leaf displaying fine, radiating line-veins)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; bold, graphical shapes; emphasize the deep, narrow finger-like cuts in the leaf canopy; seeds should look plump and slightly rubbery; avoid messy or blurry edge artifacts.

visual_logic.composition: Quadrant composition: Top-Left: a single deep green fan leaf showing its characteristic deep lobes; Top-Right: a pair of smooth, pale yellow fleshy seeds hanging together; Bottom-Left: a macro study of a stubby, wrinkled wood spur shoot; Bottom-Right: a clean golden-yellow leaf showing radiating parallel veins.
visual_logic.ground: A flat slab of light slate gray rock, providing a sharp contrast layer for the graphical silhouettes of the leaves.
visual_logic.lighting: Even, bright diffused daylight, catching the clean margins of the fan segments and the smooth curves of the seed coats.
